payload.claim: CONTEXT.md's Review pool entry explicitly says to avoid a bare "pool" (and the spec's own notes repeat "never a bare 'pool'"), but this new docstring says "the pool could not cover" rather than "REVIEW's pool" or "the review pool". The same bare usage recurs in this file's new prose at the `cover()` docstring (line 370), `run_review`'s docstring (line 416), `run_criterion_probes`'s docstring (line 566) and `run_wrong_versions`'s docstring (line 770), so it is not a one-off slip but a pattern through the new code. No gate catches it: `terms` only checks a short fixed phrase list in `.saffron/gates/prose.py`'s `AVOIDED` dict, and "pool" is not one of them.
